Claire Ng: Heads-up: launch + webinar next week. We need a small SEO task list—keywords, schema, internal links, redirects, and GTM attribution. Who can pick up what?
Evan Moore: I can do keywords and meta templates. Will assign 1 primary + 2 supporting phrases per page and share a sheet by Thu.
Priya Desai: I'll write JSON-LD for WebinarEvent + FAQPage and run Rich Results tests. Will push snippets to staging.
Mikko Tan: Redirects: 6 old docs moved under /docs/platform. I'll make a CSV and include Netlify and NGINX examples. Plan: 302 for testing then 301 live.
Claire Ng: @Evan add UTM examples (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign). @Priya mirror FAQ answers to page copy for consistent snippets. @Mikko include curl checks in PR.
Evan Moore: Initial keywords: landing page primary: "low-latency LLM inference"; support: "inference latency optimization", "LLM serving best practices". Webinar: "LLM serving webinar" + "reduce inference cost".
Priya Desai: Draft JSON-LD (staging): ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Running LLMs at Scale","startDate":"2026-04-07T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/llm-inference"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.ai/register"}}```
Mikko Tan: Example NGINX rule: rewrite ^/docs/old-guide/?$ /docs/platform/new-guide/ permanent;
Claire Ng: GTM & forms: add hidden field campaign=llm_launch_apr2026, fire event webinar_signup. SalesOps wants lead_source populated.
seo-bot: Reminder: run Structured Data test + Lighthouse on staging after schema goes up.
Claire Ng: Owners & deadlines: Evan -> keywords sheet by Thu (1753086523). Priya -> schema + test screenshots by Mon (1753219323). Mikko -> redirects CSV + PR by Fri (1753162923). I'll schedule a 15m review after assets land. Thanks!
